name: skoobi-agent
description: Telegram-first personal assistant runtime with isolated agent execution, memory, tools, and optional local integrations.

scripts.build: bash scripts/with-node22.sh sh -c 'npm run build:packages && npm run build:agent-runner && tsc && npm run build:apps'
scripts.build:agent-runner: bash scripts/with-node22.sh npm --prefix agent/runner run build
scripts.build:apps: bash scripts/with-node22.sh sh -c 'npm run build -w @skoobi/app-art-bot && npm run build -w @skoobi/app-dashboard'
scripts.typecheck: bash scripts/with-node22.sh sh -c 'npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:agent-runner && tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json'
scripts.typecheck:agent-runner: bash scripts/with-node22.sh npm --prefix agent/runner run build -- --noEmit
scripts.build:packages: bash scripts/with-node22.sh sh -c 'npm run build -w @skoobi/shared && npm run build -w @skoobi/providers && npm run build -w @skoobi/billing && npm run build -w @skoobi/payments && npm run build -w @skoobi/memory && npm run build -w @skoobi/voice-stt && npm run build -w @skoobi/voice-tts && npm run build -w @skoobi/core && npm run build -w @skoobi/channel-telegram && npm run build -w @skoobi/channel-whatsapp && npm run build -w @skoobi/dashboard'
